TWENTY-FOURTH CONGRESS OF THE FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA
THIRD REGULAR SESSION, 2026 CONGRESSIONAL BILL NO. 24-107
P.C. NO. 24-231 PUBLIC LAW NO. 24-60
AN ACT
To further amend Public Law No. 19-60, as amended by Public Laws Nos.
19-71, 19-80, 19-103, 19-148, 19-165, 20-30, 20-128, 21-46, 21-139,
22-120 and 23-100, by amending sections 4 and 6 thereof, to change the
use, allottee, and lapse date of certain funds previously appropriated
therein, for the purpose of funding essential government functions,
programs, projects, and activities in the state of Pohnpei, and for
other purposes.
BE IT ENACTED BY THE CONGRESS OF THE FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA:

6 “Section 6. Allotment and management of funds and
7 lapse date. All funds appropriated by this act shall
8 be allotted, managed, administered and accounted for
9 in accordance with applicable laws, including, but
10 not limited to, the Financial Management Act of 1979.
11 The allottee shall be responsible for ensuring that
12 these funds, or so much thereof as may be necessary,
13 are used solely for the purpose specified in this
14 act, and that no obligations are incurred in excess
15 of the sum appropriated. The allottee of the funds
16 appropriated under section 2 of this act shall be the
17 Governor of the State of Yap or his designee. The
18 allottee of the funds appropriated under section 3 of
19 this act shall be the Governor of the State of Kosrae
20 or his designee. The allottee of the funds
21 appropriated under section 4 of this act shall be the
22 Governor of the State of Pohnpei or his designee;
23 PROVIDED THAT, the allottee of the fund appropriated
24 under subsections 4(1)(c), 4(3)(a), 4(3)(c) and
25 4(4)(a) shall be the Pohnpei Transportation Authority
